release_name: Remove 9 Masses absent from the diocese pages
notes: Removed 9 Mass rows that no diocese page lists, on Louis explicit instruction after reviewing each one. This overrides the default reading of C-DATA-02 (absence is not evidence of removal) as a deliberate editorial choice that the app mirrors the official site. Removed rows archived in pipeline/removed_rows_2026-08-17.json and restorable. Two sites disappear entirely: Bon-Pasteur/Baie du Tombeau and Dans les quartiers/Plaine Magnien. Four other corpus-only rows were deliberately NOT removed - the pages do publish them and the scraper had misclassified them as non-Mass.
